caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden table with four curved legs and a wavy, scalloped tabletop edge. The wood is rendered in various shades of brown, with darker areas indicating shadows and lighter areas suggesting highlights and wood grain. The tabletop features a lighter central panel with an intricate, darker inlaid design. The table stands on a light-colored, featureless background, and a shadow is cast beneath and slightly behind the object, adding to the three-dimensional effect. The artist’s signature, “Geoffrey Holt,” is visible in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Marquetry Table, Showing Style
